Subject: Re: LumenWare MSA + Order Form intake and initial redline request

Connor / Laura / Jana —

Appended my initial pass to the thread. I attached a tracked-changes MSA and a short "redline summary". Key flags from the contract pass:

1) Liability cap: MSA currently has a mutual cap equal to 12 months of fees; recommend keeping but add carveouts for willful misconduct and IP infringement — propose removing absolute cap for IP indemnity.
2) Data residency & logs: Add specific Exhibit A obligations for US-only PII storage and 12-month audit log retention. Include our template language for access to logs on reasonable notice.
3) SLA & credits: Order Form has a 99.9% uptime target with 10% credit; propose tightening the reporting timeline and adding a maximum credit cap per month.
4) Export controls: Standard clause looks acceptable but request that customer confirm classification of model outputs as no-export restricted.

Action items for Sales / CS:
- Connor: Confirm whether customer expects any regulatory audits beyond SOC2 (HIPAA/PCI).
- Jana / Procurement: Please confirm signer and whether you require any specific DPA or security annex language beyond SOC2 references.

Attachments: LumenWare_MSA_redlines_marked.docx, LumenWare_Redline_Summary.pdf

If nothing else material emerges, I expect we can close standard redlines within 2 business days; if they insist on IP indemnity changes or a higher SLA credit, we may need escalation.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Contracts Counsel | Redwood Inference
